spec.title: AI-Native Lean card I — Scaffolded edit operations

status.comment: BETA projection; narrower checker scope and WISH gaps are explicit.

p.INTENT: Make repetitive editing deterministic only after the transformation contract is clear.

p.APPLICABILITY: A recurring multi-file proof change would benefit from one checked edit operation.

p.MOTIVATION: A reader should consume an explicit, checkable operation rather than infer a claim from prose or a stale artifact.

p.STRUCTURE: Future codemod, carrier/source migration and targeted proof checks.

p.SCOPE: Lean codemods are WISH: this runner has no source-edit command. A changed proof/subject still needs a fresh check and deliberate witness invalidation.

p.CONSEQUENCES: Makes the declared boundary reviewable; requires explicit inputs, assumptions and checker time. No broader proof grade follows.

p.ALTERNATIVES: Use a reviewed manual change while no reliable transformer exists.

p.RISKS: A transformer can preserve syntax while changing theorem meaning; require a stated relation and fail on unsupported cases. Sunset: revise or retire this card when an accepted checker/representation makes its routine obsolete.

p.EVIDENCE: No package-specific empirical result is claimed. [E-hyp]. This BETA card is grounded in the machine contract spec://org.vibevm.ai-native/lean-ai-native-lang/mechanisms/LEAN-PROOF-RUNNER#root; required runner acceptance cases are at spec://org.vibevm.ai-native/lean-ai-native-lang/mechanisms/LEAN-PROOF-RUNNER#NEGATIVE-CASES.
